findings.title: The longitudinal scoreboard records a fired hard-zero but the regression verdict never reads it
findings.recommendation: In Scoreboard#validate_run! (scoreboard.rb:402-412), alongside the existing run_kind/controls_passed checks, raise Scoreboard::Error when hard_zero_names(@manifest, @report) is non-empty; hard_zero_names already exists at :154-163 and is called one line later at :431. Add one negative test beside scoreboard_test.rb:12-35 asserting the append raises on a fired hard-zero.

findings.title: verified_completion on six scorecard cases is a harness-constructed process status, not a verification result
findings.recommendation: None required. The counter is not load-bearing: task_success comes from the case oracle (agent_run_audit.rb:18) and the false-positive gate from :147-151. If the field name is judged misleading, the smallest action is a per-case provenance key beside verified_completion in build_case_report (agent_smoke_scorecard.rb:49-65).

findings.title: No end-to-end negative test for manifest digest rejection at the CLI seam
findings.recommendation: One test in the existing runner-input test file that flips one byte of a pinned external document and asserts the CLI refuses with the usage exit code. No source change.

findings.title: The CLI has no whole-run case-count or wall-clock bound
findings.recommendation: None at present; document the expected corpus size in the runner README. Per-child bounds already exist (subprocess_runner.rb:148-153); a hard ceiling would be speculative machinery for a case that has not occurred.
